{{Quote|Daala has no political motives&mdash;she just wants to destroy things.|Han Solo|<ref name="DA" />}}
In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], renegade [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]] waged a '''military campaign''' against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. After bringing the four [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] of her [[Maw fleet]] out of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of seclusion in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]] to find that the Galactic Empire was no longer the galaxy's sole dominant power, she vowed to unleash destruction on the New Republic, the Empire's enemies. Although the Star [[Destroyer/Legends|Destroyer]] [[Hydra (Imperial I-class)|''Hydra'']] was destroyed by the stolen [[Sun Crusher]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] instantly, Daala continued with unabated furor, committing [[Speciecide|genocide]] on the people of [[Eol Sha]] by [[Attack on Dantooine (Galactic Civil War)|attacking]] their defenseless colony on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], and later bringing her [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to the New Republic world of [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. During [[Attack on Mon Calamari|battle]] there, the Star Destroyer ''[[Manticore]]'' was destroyed, and Daala retreated to the [[Cauldron Nebula/Legends|Cauldron Nebula]]. Renegade [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] student [[Kyp Durron]]&mdash;under the control of the long-dead [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]]&mdash;pursued her there with the Sun Crusher and [[Destruction of the Cauldron Nebula|ignited]] a [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] in the [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]], which also took out the Star Destroyer [[Basilisk (Star Destroyer)|''Basilisk'']]. With only the ''[[Gorgon]]'' left, Daala fought a final [[Battle of the Maw|battle]] in the Maw before limping to the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]], a stronghold of various other Imperial Warlords.
